title: Customer payments
intro: Approve customer dues, send payment links and review verified payments.
denied: Only owners, admins and agents can access customer payments.
loadError: Could not load payments. Try again.
error: Could not save this change. Check the details and refresh.
connectionHelp: Use this business’s own Razorpay API keys. Start with test keys, configure the webhook, then explicitly authorize live keys when ready. Platform subscription billing is separate.
label: Merchant label
templateHelp: Optional UTILITY template with three variables: description, INR amount, payment reference. Late receipts require matching language and contact opt-in.
liveConsent: I authorize this workspace to create real customer payment links when live keys are used.
attention: Merchant connection needs attention. Test it and check the merchant dashboard.
events: Subscribe in this merchant account to payment_link.paid, payment_link.cancelled, payment_link.expired and payment_link.partially_paid using the saved webhook secret.
disconnectPrompt: Disconnect this merchant? New links will stop. Existing links remain payable; signed webhooks will still record payments. Revoke API keys in the merchant dashboard if needed.
approvalHelp: Approve an exact amount and purpose before the bot can send a link. Amounts are INR ₹1–₹10 lakh. Paying a booking due does not confirm or reserve an appointment.
timeHelp: Enter expiry in your device timezone. Displayed dates use {timezone}. Expiry must be 5 minutes–30 days away.
limit: The latest 100 requests are shown. Customer details stay in the linked conversation.
operationError: Payment operation needs review. Refresh status and check the merchant dashboard before making another due.
cancelPrompt: Cancel this payment link? A payment already captured will remain paid.
